question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

jeopardy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"jeopardy"** means danger of loss, harm, or failure. (खतरा)
 
 
• **Example:** The decision to climb the mountain without proper equipment put their lives in jeopardy.
 
 
 
• **"Safety" **refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury. (सुरक्षा)
 
 
• **Example:** Wearing a seatbelt in the car is an important safety measure.
